==Hero Usage==
* Heroes use this spell as a generic heal, however, they do not consider the fact that it heals after the enchantment has ended. They may use this skill and then immediately use another skill that causes healing without waiting for Patient Spirit to expire. As such, they can often waste energy by overhealing.

== Notes ==
* [[Unyielding Aura]], [[Healer's Covenant]], [[Aura of Faith]] and [[Healer's Boon]] affect the healing done by this skill, if they're active the moment the healing occurs. See [[Heal#Healing modifiers|healing modifiers]] for details.
*An [[of Enchanting]] weapon mod will make Patient Spirit end after 3 seconds instead of 2. Consider using weapons without this mod for faster healing.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
